cover.title: 5 niche ways to get chatgpt to quote your price in euros

inner.title: show the euro price
inner.body: google's merchant rules say to show the price in the currency of the target country, prominently, on landing and checkout pages. a dollar-only pricing page makes every european buyer do the conversion for you.

inner.title: vat in the number
inner.body: google merchant centre asks for prices including vat in countries like germany, france, italy and spain, and the landing page price must match the data. a net price on the page makes your own two prices disagree.

inner.title: mark up the price
inner.body: google's merchant listing docs mark up the live price with a price field and a currency code beside it. a price that only exists inside an image has no number for anyone to read.

inner.title: let the search bot in
inner.body: openai says sites opted out of oai-searchbot will not be shown in chatgpt search answers, and a robots.txt change takes about 24 hours to apply. blocking gptbot is a separate switch, so check which one you flipped.

inner.title: check your firewall
inner.body: openai publishes ip ranges for its search bot and recommends allowing them. a firewall rule can block the crawler even when robots.txt says yes, and you never see the answer that left you out.
